needed.evidence: A food-trailer and a pink tarp are parked on the brick footway, leaving only a narrow, partly blocked strip for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Relocate the food-trailer and its goods to the carriageway or a designated market bay so the full-width brick footway is clear.

needed.evidence: The food-trailer and pink tarp occupy most of the brick footway, forcing pedestrians to squeeze past or step into the road.
needed.suggestion: Provide a marked, off-street market bay for the trailer so the footway is not used as a loading area.

needed.evidence: People are standing on both footways and the food-trailer creates a destination, but there is no marked or raised crossing in view.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with dropped kerbs at the point where the footways meet the carriageway in front of the food-trailer.

needed.evidence: No street lamps are visible along this urban street, which is lit only by daylight and event bunting.
needed.suggestion: Fit a row of LED street lamps on both sides of the carriageway to illuminate the footways and any future crossing.
